```plato
    // The average velocity over [earlier, later]: displacement over elapsed
    // seconds. Precondition: earlier and later differ.
    AverageVelocityBetween(self: IKinematic2D, earlier: Duration, later: Duration): Vector2D
        => self.PositionAt(earlier).Between(self.PositionAt(later)) / (later.Seconds - earlier.Seconds);
```
